heading: **5 February 2026**
body:
*ELF-nucleosome interaction assay*

Prepare protein stocks of both ELF2-2 and ELF2m3 ⇒ 1 uL of each protein \+ 3 uL 50 mM TF dilution buffer (75 mM salt concentration)

![](assets/img/doc3-image9.png)

*ELF-DNA interaction assay*

Amount of DNA \= 30 ng

![](assets/img/doc3-image10.png)

For both the reactions, incubate RT, 15-20 mins. Followed by addition of 2 uL of rCutsmart buffer, 1 uL of EcoRV ⇒ Incubate at 37 C, 15 mins.

Follow this with addition of 0.2 uL 10% SDS & 0.4 uL Proteinase K ⇒ Incubate 55 C, 10 mins.

*SBP-Octamer stock plate*

Total number of experiments using Octamer ⇒ (5 X lig200) \+( 5 X lig70N) \+ (1X lig147) \+ (1X lig40N) ⇒ We roughly use 1.8 uL per well (28 ng/uL) ⇒ For 12 plates this works out to be 8640 uL (241.92 ug)

33.4 uL Octamer stock (7.25 mg/mL) \+ 259.2 uL 100 mM TCEP \+ 8347.4 uL (Refolding Buffer \+ Glycerol)

Mix well and aliquot 720 uL per well along a single row of a deep storage plate and then aliquot to 90 uL per well of a 4titude 96-well plate. From here use the robot to aliquot to 22.5 uL per well of a 384-well 4titude plate for storage.

*Dried salt plates for reconstitution*

**sol1 Salt solution: 2M KCl\_1.491g KCl \+ 10mL TE \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 1mM TCEP**

50 mL

| KCl | 7.46 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 0.5 mLcas9 |
| TE Buffer (100X) | 0.5 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 1 tablet |

Filter, mix well and aliquot.

Add 130 uL per well of 2 X  4titude 96-well plates. Use one plate for making 6 384-well NUNC plate aliquots.

*In vitro CRISPR for Plasmid FIBER-seq*

Alt-R Cas9 Neg Ctrl crRNA \#1, 2 nmol → Resuspend in 20 uL TE buffer for a 100 uM stock

crRNA → Resuspend in 100 uL TE buffer for a 100 uM stock

Alt-R CRISPR-Cas9 tracrRNA, 20 nmol → Resuspend in 200 uL TE buffer for a 100 uM stock

Dissolve all crRNA, tracrRNA tubes by adding TE buffer and then placing at RT for 15 mins. Briefly vortex and spin down.

Alt-R™ S.p. Cas9 Nuclease V3, 100 µg → Provided at a 10ug/uL (61 uM) solution

10X Cas9 Nuclease reaction buffer:

1 mL

| 1 M HEPES  | 200 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| NaCl | 0.06 g |
| 1 M MgCl2 | 50 uL |
| 0.5 M EDTA | 2 uL |

Filter and store at \-20 before usage.

Cas9 dilution Buffer:

10 mL

| 1 M HEPES  | 300 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 4 M KCl | 375 uL |
